messages:
Alice Chen: Starting v2 rollout to canary shard A in ~10m. DeployBot will do a slow ramp (2% -> 10%). Watch for 4xx/5xx and tokenization regressions.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary start scheduled 2026-03-18T10:00:00Z. Initial target: 2% traffic on shard A. Health checks: /health, 200s, p50/p95 latency. Cmd: `deploybot start-canary --route /v2/generate --shard A --targets 2,5,10`

Chris Patel: +1. Quick FYI: v2 now accepts Content-Type with `charset=utf-8` (we normalize), but some older client SDKs reject non-exact header values (415). Could see mobile SDKs error out. Anyone seen preflight failures?

Maria Gomez: We have one failing mobile preflight from QA: `415 Unsupported Media Type` when `Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8` is sent. Looks like the mobile SDK's HTTP client does strict matching. Recommend pinning affected tenants while we push an SDK patch and a release notes note.

Sam N: I can add a tenant-level pin. Suggest: pin `tenant:acme-corp` to v1 for 24h and pause ramp until we confirm no fresh failures. Rollback/trip criteria: >0.5% 5xx for 5m OR p95 latency >2x baseline for 10m. Command: `deploybot pin-tenant acme-corp v1 --duration 24h && deploybot pause-ramp /v2/generate --shard A`

Alice Chen: Do that now. Also add an entry in release notes: call out header tolerance change and SDK patch link. I'll notify CS and post a brief customer advisory for tenants we pin. Pausing the ramp at 5% until pins are applied.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: tenant pin applied -> acme-corp pinned to v1 until 2026-03-19T10:00:00Z. Canary ramp paused at 5%. Monitoring enabled on: /v2/generate (p50,p95,5xx). Alerts: #eng-oncall, #customer-success if trip criteria hit.
